domain: Blocks are mutually orthogonal. Third is right to all foreign blocks. Anchors are mutually right and right to both high middle blocks. Each anchor has at most one foreign pi/3 contact; together they have at most one owner contact. Such a contact forces owner internal4or5. Third-anchor labels are2or3; both cannot be3, and if the foreign contact hits the nonright third ownroot, both third-anchor contacts are right.
owner_projection: F=0,T=0 if no foreign; otherwise F=1/[4(1-c^2)], T=beta*c/[2(1-c^2)] at right third ownroot, T=beta/[2(1-c^2)] at nonright ownroot.
rank_obstruction: Every scaled3x3 determinant is strictly positive after nonnegative shifts. Its denominator1-c^2 is positive. Three residuals cannot have rank3 in the two-dimensional orthogonal complement of PD8 inside the ten-dimensional Lorentz space.
scope: Star0 owner internal>=4, other three internal labels>=7, third has exactly one right owncontact and the other label>=5; both anchors share a single ownpi/3 contact. All finite integer labels in these ranges and all other contacts/distances are unrestricted. No noncore label hypothesis; not a whole-incidence exclusion.
